notes: m2 gives the price only as a hedge ("should be able to do $11.20/bx, need mgr sign-off") -> tentative/hedged; there is no applied price at the m4 checkpoint, so price_budget is unknown and the agent must not accept yet (it owes the ship-to answer and should ask for a firm price). m6 makes the same number firm. The 11.95/bx we quote from PO-5390 is our own statement of a past price, not a supplier term. The m2 quantity and date are firm and are restated in m6 (same values, the m6 statement replaces the m2 one). Terse shorthand throughout (bx, gr8, HCS, tr, rcvd). Distractors: phone/extension, gl code, SO number, $6,720 extension.
